title: Appointed as Assistant
original: You would like me to take care of your secretarial work? I can, but please do keep the amount of work under control. I used to write reports fairly often, but most don't find the contents of my reports very pleasant to read.

title: Talk 1
original: You can stop looking at my shoulder. This is not an Oripathy lesion. It's just a tattoo that resembles one. Why? To outwit anyone who thinks they've found a weakness. You won't bother me again after the first time you guess wrong.

title: Talk 2
original: That's right. I became an Infected while I was testing this railgun. Why am I still using it? First, it's safe now that it has been fine-tuned. Secondly, while I don't want to admit it, this is the weapon that suits me the most. I don't want to or dare to abandon it.

title: Talk 3
original: The medicine in my earrings? It's not medicine. It's a perfume that I mixed myself. A highly concentrated perfume that can induce... emotions that run opposite to hostility. It comes in handy in dangerous situations. As for the lower concentrated one that I have here... Umm, it's for alleviating carsickness. I tend to get carsick pretty badly.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I'd say I was a mercenary, more than a weapons tester. As soon as the higher-ups gave the order, I would have to take to the battlefield with newly-issued equipment. It was nothing like the battles I've fought for Rhodes Island. No one knew or cared why I fought.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: I was infected not because of an accident, but because of a transaction. For my infection, the client got their data, and the provided got a significant payment. Plus, they got to keep me on a leash with their insurance... If it wasn't for them treating me like a tuskbeast, why would I have run?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: The first time I struck a dummy, I thought back to my parents, that bandit, and how powerless I was despite having a gun in my hand... Even after I was out of ammo, I was still mechanically pulling the trigger over and over, until the coach took away the launcher in my hand. That's right. A launcher, not a gun.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I once thought about opening a sundries shop like my parents did. Once, I even had an agreement with a landlord. Then, I had nightmares that entire night... Now? Much better. I'm even trying to help Instructor Dur-nar—Oh, please don't tell anyone about this.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: My father used to tell me stories of how the great Blacksteel founder upgraded their firearms. But it wasn't until recently that I realized true greatness is not to popularize some kind of weapon. Instead, it's to make weapons useless forever. Right, it's very ironic. This is what I dream of achieving, and it is something that I can only dream of achieving.

title: Idle
original: Please rest at ease. I will ensure the office's safety during this period of time.

title: Onboard
original: Nice to meet you, Doctor. As a field operator, I will be in your service from here onwards. I hope that my firepower will not betray your expectations.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: That is excellent CQC, but perhaps a little too dangerous...

title: Promotion 1
original: The only way my former employer expresses approval is by raising wages—Don't get the wrong idea. For every wage increase, they make you do ten times the work afterwards. That's not how Rhodes Island works, right?

title: Promotion 2
original: Thank you for your trust, Doctor. I used to think of Rhodes Island as a stopping point so beautiful that it's almost unreal, but it now seems I will have to extend my stay here for a little longer.

title: Added to Squad
original: I'll provide fire support for everyone.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: You are appointing me as the leader? It appears this will be a tough battle.

title: Depart
original: Everyone, so that we don't run into any unexpected issues on the field, check your weapons once again.

title: Begin Operation
original: Maintain a safe distance. Avoid direct confrontation if possible.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm here.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Your command?

title: Deployment 1
original: Adjusting firing trajectory... Complete.

title: Deployment 2
original: Weapon's good. Ready for data collection.

title: In Battle 1
original: Shh. Do you hear that? That's the sound of the reaper making her advent.

title: In Battle 2
original: Laying suppressive fire.

title: In Battle 3
original: Maximum output reached.

title: In Battle 4
original: Don't huddle there. Hard for me to assess the blast area.

title: 4-star Result
original: I... I'm suddenly a little terrified. If I were on the other side facing you and your command, how much of the firepower I'm so proud of would actually be effective?

title: 3-star Result
original: A perfect performance, to the point that I want to write an evaluation report, voluntarily.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: A few of them got away. It seems we need some further adjustments.

title: Operation Failure
original: Cover the retreat? No problem. It's important to evaluate performance during retreats, too.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Considering the weapon's size, this place might be a little cramped.

title: Tap
original: Doctor, don't touch. You could get hurt.

title: Trust Tap
original: Would you like to head to Engineering together?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy New Year, Doctor. Would you like me to launch fireworks with this launcher? No, this isn't a metaphor. It really has a fireworks mode. It has always had one ever since I got it for the first time.

title: Greeting
original: Good morning. A dream-less night of sleep alleviates exhaustion the most, don't you think?

title: Birthday
original: My former coworkers celebrated each safe return from a mission like a birthday. I wasn't very fond of chumming with them. The craze they put up like they outlived a disaster always made me feel sick—I'm sorry, Doctor. I shouldn't be saying this today. Happy birthday.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Rhodes Island is a place where one can discuss their ideals without feeling embarrassed, and I like that. If I could start over, I would have come straight here without becoming a weapons tester... That way, perhaps I would already have taken a step toward my ideals already.
